description: No spec subject (candidates: specled.severity when picked up). Severity: Low. From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. A Spec-Drift commit trailer that escalates/relaxes a finding changes the resolved severity but the report never says a trailer did it — the override is invisible in output. Keep-reason: report-format addition, out of scope for the shipped defect-fix branch. Concrete failure: a reviewer reading spec.check output cannot distinguish a config default from a per-commit trailer override, so an escaped relaxation trailer passes unnoticed.
title: F11: Spec-Drift trailer override leaves no trace in report output
